# 天机阁 · Algorithm Codex
> English · 中文 · Español · Português · हिन्दी

The plugin is the *interface*; the codex itself lives in the `algo-hub` repository one level up
(`da
ta/algorithms.json` + `data/taxonomy.json`). A standalone install carries a seed snapshot (`seed/`)
and seeds `~/.dsh/tianjige` on first run, so the same package works without the repository.
## Features

- **Search** — `tianji_search` finds algorithms by natural language or keywords, with filters for
do

main, function key, maturity and “has a ready implementation”. Strict match first, partial
match as

a fallback, clickable repo/package links in the result.
- **Dossier** — `tianji_get` returns one ful

l entry: how it works, tradeoffs, complexity, papers,
implementations, sibling variants of the same

function, caveats.
- **Ask** — `tianji_ask` lets the model answer a design question from the codex f

irst, and opt in
to a web search for algorithms outside it (`findNew: true`).
- **Sweep** — `tianji_

sweep` searches the web for new algorithms, turns them into candidate drafts
under `data/pending/`,

and can run on a daily schedule (`action=status|start|config`).
- **Curation** — `tianji_stage` / `t

ianji_update` / `tianji_review` / `tianji_review_mark` /
`tianji_stats` / `tianji_usage` cover addin

g, editing, reviewing, auditing and token accounting.
- **UI** — a left-sidebar row opens a full-pag

e view with four tabs (Codex / Arena / Sweep / Ask),
and the same page is also available as a right-

four tabs (Codex / Arena / Sweep / Ask),
and the same page is also available as a right-sidebar tab.
## Install
The package is the `tianjige-plugin/` directory. Install it into a DSH profile and enable it:

Use your own profile name instead of `desktop` if you run a different one. Restart DSH afterwards:
t
he host half is imported once at startup and a page refresh does not reload it. Before restarting yo

u
can smoke-check the sources with `node --check host.js` and `node --check lib/*.mjs`.
## Configuration
The plugin inserts one row (`id: tianjige`) through `cordis.patch.yml`. Both keys are optional:
| Key | Default | Meaning |
| `dataDir` | parent directory of this package (= repository root) | codex root containing `data/` a

nd `server/ai.mjs` |
| `defaultLimit` | `8` | default number of rows returned by `tianji_search` |
[代码示例省略，未执行]
## Data layout
[代码示例省略，未执行]
When the plugin is installed from npm there is no repository around it, so the first run copies the
bundled starter library (`seed/algorithms.json`, `seed/taxonomy.json`) into `~/.dsh/tianjige` and ke
eps every write there. Set `dataDir` (or `DSH_TIANJIGE_DATA_DIR`) to override; a link / development
install keeps using the repository root.
## Compatibility

and the AI layer are loa

ded by dynamic import, so a copy inside a profile can never shadow the
runtime version.
- AI tools (

ask / sweep / AI-assisted review) need `DEEPSEEK_API_KEY`: an environment variable, or
a `DEEPSEEK_A

PI_KEY:` line in `~/.dsh/.credentials.yaml`. Without a key the other tools keep
working and the AI t

ools return `AI_NO_KEY`.
- The only peer dependency is `react` (client half, provided by the harness

## Tools
| Tool | Purpose |
| `tianji_search` | Search entries (`query`, optional `domain` / `functionKey` / `maturity` / `hasIm

pl` / `limit`) |
| `tianji_get` | Full dossier by `id` |
| `tianji_ask` | Natural-language design qu

estion (`task`, optional `findNew` web search) |
| `tianji_sweep` | Sweep: `action=status` / `start`

/ `config` (daily auto-sweep switch and interval) |
| `tianji_stage` | Stage a new candidate (write

s `data/staging/`, waits for human merge) |
| `tianji_update` | Edit an existing entry in place (aut

omatic backup) |
| `tianji_review` / `tianji_review_mark` | Review queue: list items / record a verd

ict |
| `tianji_stats` | Codex audit: entry count, domain spread, implementation coverage, review pr

ogress |
| `tianji_usage` | AI token ledger (read / delete / clear / retention) |
## UI surfaces
The plugin registers three seats:

- `sidebar.panellist` — one row “天机阁” in the left sidebar (`order: 120`)
- `main` — a full-page view

opened from that row (tabs: Codex / Arena / Sweep / Ask)
- `sidebar.right.pane.tab` — the same page
as a right-sidebar tab
Page data goes through host routes `/api/tianjige/{library,meta,sweep,ask,review,usage,write,log}`,

which accept loopback requests only. Without a `webServer` service the plugin degrades to
“tools onl

loopback requests only. Without a `webServer` service the plugin degrades to
“tools only, no page”.
## Troubleshooting

- **Nothing shows up after install** — restart DSH first; then check the `application` field
returne

d by `plugin_manager`.
- **Page says “sweep status unavailable”** — usually a dependency module fail

ed to load (for
example a missing `lib/ai.mjs`); the route writes the error into the `/api/tianjige/

meta` 500
response. Check with `node --check lib/sweep.mjs`.
- **`AI_NO_KEY` from `tianji_ask`** — c

onfigure the key as described under Compatibility.
- **Data validation** — `python tools/algohub.py

validate` (expect 0 errors, 0 warnings) and
`doctor` for reference checks.
## Development

- Host: `host.js` (entry, tools + routes), `lib/sweep.mjs` (sweep / review / ask),
`lib/ai.mjs` (AI

calls and prompts), `lib/usage.mjs` (token ledger), `lib/entries.mjs`
(entry read/write helpers).
-

Client: `lib/client.js` (React, single-file bundle registered into a slot).
- Tests: `npm test` runs

`node --test test/smoke.test.mjs` — offline, zero dependencies, against
`test/fixtures/`; it never

touches real data and does not need the plugin to be installed.
- Static checks: `dsh-plugin-dev che

ck --strict` (from the `dsh-plugin-guide` skill package) and
`node --check` on every entry.
